friction_specification.reconciliation_note: In Sprint 11.12 benchmark manifest, roundtrip_friction_pct was documented as 0.0025 (25 bps) due to a typo omitting exit slippage. The underlying simulator executed 10 bps entry fee + 10 bps exit fee + 5 bps entry slippage + 5 bps exit slippage = 30 bps (0.0030). Policy V2 officially corrects the documented benchmark specification to match true execution.

portfolio_accounting_rules.order_fill_price: open * (1.0 + slippage_pct) for BUY, close * (1.0 - slippage_pct) for SELL
portfolio_accounting_rules.intrabar_priority: Pessimistic: STOP_LOSS evaluated before TAKE_PROFIT if both touched
